Bank Math Master.question: ১) It was Sunday on Jan 1, 2006. What was the day of the week Jan 2, 2010?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: It was Sunday on Jan 1, 2006. What was the day of the week Jan 1, 2010?

Solution: 
On 31st December, 2005 it was Saturday.
Number of odd days from the year 2006 to the year 2009 = (1 + 1 + 2 + 1) = 5 days.
∴ On 31st December 2009, it was Thursday. 
Thus, on  Jan 2, 2010 it is  Saturday.

Bank Math Master.question: ৩) In how many ways 6 students can be chosen from the class of 10 students?

Bank Math Master.question: ৪)  An accurate clock shows 8 o'clock in the morning. Through how many degrees will the hour hand rotate when the clock shows 2 o'clock in the afternoon?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: An accurate clock shows 8 o'clock in the morning. Through how many degrees will the hour hand rotate when the clock shows 2 o'clock in the afternoon?

Solution: 
From 8 o'clock to 20'clock total time is 6 hours.

Hours hand makes,
in 12 hours = 360° angle
in 6 hours = (360° × 6)/12
= 180°

Bank Math Master.question: ৫)  Today is Monday. After 61 days, it will be:
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: Today is Monday. After 61 days, it will be:

Solution:
Each day of the week is repeated after 7 days.
So, after 63 days, it will be Monday.
∴ After 61 days, it will be Saturday.

Bank Math Master.question: ৬) cos 80°cos20° + sin80°sin20° =?
Bank Math Master.exp:
প্রশ্ন: cos 80°cos20° + sin80°sin20° =?

সমাধান:

cos(A - B) = cosA cosB + sinA sinB

∴ cos 80° cos 20° + sin 80° sin 20°
= cos(80° - 20°)
= cos60°

Bank Math Master.question: ৮) Find the angle of elevation of the sun when the shadow of a pole of 18 m height is 6√3 long.
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: Find the angle of elevation of the sun when the shadow of a pole of 18 m height is 6√3 long.

Solution: 


shadow = base = 6√3 m
height =18 m

let, angle of elevation θ

tanθ = 18/6√3
⇒ tanθ = 3/√3
⇒ tanθ = √3
⇒ tanθ = tan60°
∴ θ = 60°

Bank Math Master.question: ৯)  If (sinθ + cosθ)/(sinθ - cosθ) = 5 , then, tanθ =?
Bank Math Master.exp:
প্রশ্ন: If (sinθ + cosθ)/(sinθ - cosθ) = 5 , then, tanθ =? 

সমাধান:
5(sinθ - cosθ) = sinθ + cosθ
বা, 5sinθ - 5cosθ = sinθ + cosθ
বা,5sinθ - sinθ = cosθ + 5cosθ
বা, 4sinθ = 6cosθ
বা, sinθ/cosθ = 6/4
∴ tanθ = 3/2

Bank Math Master.question: ১১) <sup>4</sup>P<sub>2</sub> - <sup>4</sup>C<sub>2</sub> =?
Bank Math Master.exp:
প্রশ্ন: 4P2 - 4C2 =?

সমাধান: 
4P2
= 4!/(4 - 2)!
= 4!/2!
= 12

4C2
= 4!/2!(4 - 2)!
= 4!/2! 2!
= 6

∴ 5P2 - 5C2 = 12 - 6
= 6

Bank Math Master.question: ১৪) A committee of 3 members is to be formed by selecting out of 5 men and 4 women. In how many different ways the committee can be formed if it should have 1 man and 2 women?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: A committee of 3 members is to be formed by selecting out of 5 men and 4 women. In how many different ways can the committee be formed if it should have 1 man and 2 women?

Solution:
We can select 1 man from 5 men in
= 5C1 ways
= 5 ways 

Selecting 2 women from 4 women in
= 4C2
= 6

∴ The committee can be formed
= 5 × 6
= 30 ways

Bank Math Master.question: ১৫) If sinA + sin<sup>2</sup>A = 1 then, cos<sup>2</sup>A + cos<sup>4</sup>A =?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: If sinA + sin2A = 1 then, cos2A + cos4A =? 

Solution: 
sinA + sin2A = 1
বা, sinA = 1 - sin2A
বা, sinA = cos2A

cos2A + cos4A
= cos2A + (cos2A)2
= cos2A + sin2A

Bank Math Master.question: ১৬) If sinA = cos2A,  A =?
Bank Math Master.exp:
প্রশ্ন: If sinA = cos2A,  A =?

সমাধান:
sinA = cos2A
⇒ sinA = 1 - 2 sin2A
⇒ 2 sin2A + sinA - 1 = 0
⇒ 2 sin2A + 2 sinA - sinA -1 = 0
⇒ 2 sinA ( sinA + 1) -1 (sinA + 1) = 0
⇒ (sinA + 1) (2 sinA -1) = 0

হয়, sinA + 1 = 0 
⇒ sinA = -1 
⇒ A = 270° 

অথবা 2 sinA - 1 = 0
⇒ sinA = 1/2
⇒ A = 30°

Bank Math Master.question: ১৭) How many 3-digit numbers can be formed from the digits 2, 3, 5, 6, and 7, which are divisible by 5 and none of the digits is repeated?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: How many 3-digit numbers can be formed from the digits 2, 3, 5, 6, and 7, which are divisible by 5 and none of the digits is repeated?

Solution:
Number will be divisible by 5 if the last number is 5.

So, first number can be chosen in 4C1 ways 
= 4 ways

AS the digit is not repeated
second number can be chosen in 3C1 
= 3 ways

∴ Total ways = 4 × 3 ways
= 12 ways

Bank Math Master.question: ২০) In how many ways can 5 examination papers be arranged so that the best and the worst papers never come together?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: In how many ways can 5 examination papers be arranged so that the best and the worst papers never come together?

Solution:
Total ways = 5!
= 120 ways

if two papers come together, we can consider them one.
ways that they will come together = 4! × 2!
= 24 × 2
= 48 ways

∴ ways the best and the worst papers never come together = 120 - 48 ways
= 72 ways

Bank Math Master.question: ২৪)  The angle of elevation of a ladder leaning against a wall is 60° and the foot of the ladder is 4.5 m away from the wall. The length of the ladder is:
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: The angle of elevation of a ladder leaning against a wall is 60° and the foot of the ladder is 4.5 m away from the wall. The length of the ladder is:

Solution:
Let,
AB be the wall and BC be the ladder.
Then, ∠ACB = 60° and AC = 4.5 m.

Here, 
AC/BC = cos60°
⇒ AC/BC = 1/2 
⇒ BC = 2 × AC 
⇒ BC = 2 × 4.5
∴ BC = 9 

∴ The length of the ladder is 9 m.

Bank Math Master.question: ২৫) How many days are there in n weeks n days?
Bank Math Master.exp:
প্রশ্ন: How many days are there in n weeks n days?

সমাধান:  
In one week there are 7 days.
So in n weeks, there are 7n days

∴ total days = 7n + n = 8n
